name: Destructeur 1
description: Ingénieur militaire déployant les infrastructures d'occupation sur les planètes récemment conquises.

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek carmine‑red plate armor, seamless and smooth, with an integrated full‑face helmet bearing an opaque visor and a thin horizontal red slit; angular shoulders adorned with an asymmetrical dark‑gray half‑cape; tight ballistic fabric underlayer for martial silhouette
loadout.arsenal: Massive rectangular electromagnetic railgun with hexagonal cooling vents and sleek fuyante lines; thermal energy sword with a glowing red blade emitting a faint smoky haze; compact plasma cutter for rapid infrastructure deployment

attitude.behavior: Standing on a ridge of a barren conquered planet, one hand gripping the railgun, the other guiding a hovering construction drone that assembles metallic scaffolding; boots planted on scorched ground, posture rigid and commanding
attitude.emotion: Cold, methodical determination hidden behind the red‑lit visor; a focused, almost robotic intensity that conveys absolute authority and technological supremacy

palette_names.name: Carmine Red
palette_names.role: Primary armor and dominant surface color (60%)

palette_names.name: Dark Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary armor plates, half‑cape, and ground elements (30%)

palette_names.name: Neon Red Glow
palette_names.role: Visor slit, plasma effects, railgun muzzle glow, thermal sword emission (10%)

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with harsh red backlight, subtle ambient fill from the planetary horizon, localized neon accents illuminating weapons and visor

camera.angle: Low angle with slight dutch tilt to accentuate dominance, eye‑level focus on the subject

scenography.setting: Barren alien landscape of a newly conquered planet, jagged rock formations, distant red sky shrouded in dust, massive metallic occupation modules being erected, stark geometric structures in carmine and gray
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Red dust storms, faint neon sparks from railgun discharge, plasma cutter beams cutting through metal, distant thunderous rumble of heavy machinery, subtle holographic schematics flickering over the scaffolding
